content.text: I have everything I need. Here is the plan.

input.summary: `setLabelLineState()` in src/label/labelGuideHelper.ts only writes `shape.smooth` when the resolved value is `> 0`, so a label-line Polyline that is reused across `setOption` keeps its previous smooth value when `labelLine.smooth` is changed back to `false`/`0`/unset — the guide line stays curved. The fix is to always write the resolved smooth (0 when disabled) for the normal state, while keeping non-normal states inheriting from normal when they do not configure `smooth` themselves. No new public option is needed.
steps: DO NOT simplify this to an unconditional `shape.smooth = smooth > 0 ? smooth : 0` for every state. `setLabelLineStyle` (same file, lines 608-646) calls `setLabelLineState` for every entry of DISPLAY_STATES, and `getLabelLineStatesModels` (lines 665-678) builds `emphasis`/`blur`/`select` models via `itemModel.getModel([stateName, 'labelLine'])`, which resolve to `undefined` for `smooth` unless the user explicitly set `emphasis.labelLine.smooth`. zrender's `Path._applyStateObj` (/workspace/node_modules/zrender/src/graphic/Path.ts:521-579) merges `state.shape` over `normalState.shape`, so writing `smooth: 0` into the emphasis state object would flatten a normally-smoothed guide line on hover/blur/select — a regression. The `smooth != null` guard above preserves the current inheritance behaviour.

OPTIONAL micro-cleanup in the same block (lines 542-545): `if (smooth && smooth === true) { smooth = 0.3; }` is redundant — `if (smooth === true)` is equivalent. Safe to tidy while editing, but not required by the requirement; keep the 0.3 default for `smooth: true` either way.

NO REDRAW PLUMBING NEEDED — verify only. Writing `shape.smooth` directly does not call `dirtyShape()`, but every consumer re-sets the points right after via `setShape` (which always dirties): pie /workspace/src/chart/pie/labelLayout.ts:580 `labelLine.setShape({ points: linePoints });` (invoked from PieView.render at /workspace/src/chart/pie/PieView.ts:297 `labelLayout(seriesModel);`), funnel /workspace/src/chart/funnel/FunnelView.ts:146, and generic labels via `updateLabelLinePoints` (/workspace/src/label/labelGuideHelper.ts:400) called from /workspace/src/label/LabelManager.ts:328 and :509. If you want belt-and-braces, add `isNormal && labelLine.dirtyShape();` after the smooth assignment — harmless, but not necessary.

NO PUBLIC OPTION / TYPE CHANGES. `LabelLineOption.smooth?: boolean | number` already exists at /workspace/src/util/types.ts:1389-1400 (line 1397). The pie default stays `smooth: false` at /workspace/src/chart/pie/PieSeries.ts:283 (inside the `labelLine` defaultOption block, lines 277-289). Funnel has no `smooth` default, which is exactly why the `else if (isNormal) { shape.smooth = 0; }` branch is required — `stateModel.get('smooth')` returns `undefined` there.

ADD A UNIT TEST — there is currently no coverage for label lines under /workspace/test/ut/spec (no `label/` dir; verified with `grep -rn "smooth" /workspace/test/ut/spec` → no hits). Create /workspace/test/ut/spec/label/labelLine.test.ts with the standard Apache license header (copy the 19-line header from /workspace/test/ut/spec/api/getVisual.test.ts), `import { createChart, getECModel } from '../../core/utHelper';`. Test body: create a pie chart with `series: [{type: 'pie', label: {position: 'outer'}, labelLine: {show: true, smooth: 0.4}, data: [...]}]`, grab the sector element (walk the series view group via `getViewGroup(chart, 'series', 0)` / `getGraphicElements` from /workspace/test/ut/core/utHelper.ts:119-150, or `chart.getModel().getSeriesByIndex(0)` + `chart._chartsMap`), read `sector.getTextGuideLine().shape.smooth` and expect `0.4`; then `chart.setOption({series: [{labelLine: {smooth: false}}]})` and expect `shape.smooth` to be `0` (repeat for `smooth: 0`). Add a second case asserting that with normal `smooth: 0.4` and no `emphasis.labelLine`, `labelLine.states.emphasis.shape.smooth` is `undefined` (guards against the regression described in step 3).

OPTIONAL MANUAL TEST — /workspace/test/pie-label.html already has cases using `labelLine: {smooth: true}` (line 151) and `smooth: true` (line 687). Adding a small button/`chart.setOption` toggle that flips `labelLine.smooth` between `0.3` and `false` in one of those cases gives a visual repro; purely optional, no build/theme/index.d.ts changes are involved in this fix.
input.risks: 1) The main subtlety is state inheritance: an unconditional write would break `emphasis`/`blur`/`select`, because `setLabelLineStyle` always ensures those states with a `shape = {}` object and zrender merges state shape over the normal shape. The proposed `smooth != null` / `isNormal` guards avoid this, but any reviewer-suggested "simplification" back to a single assignment re-introduces the regression. 2) Typing: `stateModel` is `Model` (ModelOption is loosely typed), so `smooth` is effectively `any`; the `as number` casts and the `stateObj.shape as Polyline['shape']` cast must be kept or `tsc` will complain about `boolean | number` vs `number` (zrender PolylineShape declares `smooth?: number = 0`, /workspace/node_modules/zrender/src/graphic/shape/Polyline.ts:13). 3) Edge case left unfixed (pre-existing, out of scope): if `setLabelLineState` runs while the element is currently in a non-normal state, zrender restores `_normalState.shape` on state exit, so a smooth reset applied at that instant could be reverted; normal `setOption` re-renders happen in the normal state, so this is not the reported bug. 4) `src/label/labelGuideHelper.ts` is shared by pie, funnel and the generic LabelManager path — the fix affects all three, which is desired, but funnel/LabelManager have no `smooth` default so they now explicitly get `smooth = 0` on the normal shape (same rendered result as today's `undefined`, since `buildLabelLinePath` tests `smooth > 0`).
